title: WorkItemTree
description: Canonical hierarchy produced by the leveling engine, ready for distillation and MCP write-back. Single source of truth — generate TS types (shared/ts) and pydantic models (shared/py) from this file.

warnings.description: Non-fatal integrity signals surfaced to a human reviewer. Always [] for BASELINE.

page_end.description: Last page this node's folded content covers. Null means same as page, or unknown -- never set without page also being set.

page_provenance.description: Null when page/page_end came from the file's own real pagination (PDF, OCR, pptx slide index). 'rendered' when derived by re-rendering the source through a different layout engine (e.g. docx converted to PDF for pagination purposes). 'interpolated' when bracketed between confidently-matched anchors rather than directly matched.

section_path.description: Root-first heading/section labels for the section this ref was parsed from, e.g. ["3 Power", "3.2 Backplane"]. Empty when no heading ancestry applies.

fidelity_hash.description: sha256 over the normalized verbatim source span. Required in BASELINE mode, null in SURVEY.

identity_hash.description: Idempotency key input (orchestrator's sourceHash): description + this node's own fixed source position. Distinct from fidelity_hash (drift detection). Null for a node shape predating this field.

figure_ids.description: Ids of figures folded into/relevant to this node -- populated by all 4 node-building paths (BASELINE, deterministic heading/ID-tree, deterministic span-fold, SURVEY's LLM branch), not SURVEY-only. For SURVEY this is the LLM's own judged-relevant subset (see llm_leveling.render_section's figure id injection); for the deterministic paths it's every figure whose block folded into this node's span, no LLM judgment involved.

table_ids.description: Ids of tables folded into/relevant to this node -- populated by all 4 node-building paths, not SURVEY-only (see figure_ids' description for the same distinction). A non-empty list means that table's HTML is already embedded into `description` (see _table_to_html).

uncaptioned_figure_ids.description: Figures that folded into this node's span but produced no caption (vision disabled, the vision call failed, or the model returned the no-technical-content sentinel) -- disjoint from figure_ids, a figure id appears in exactly one of the two lists.

child_type.description: Default work-item type for a new manual child added under this node. Null when ineligible or unresolvable.

grounding_score.description: SURVEY-only: how much of the generated description's vocabulary appears in its source block. Null for BASELINE (trivially fully grounded) or when scoring wasn't enabled.

quality_score.description: SURVEY-only: 0-100 quality judgment of the final description. Null for BASELINE or when no scoring_client was supplied.

quality_category_scores.description: Per-dimension 0-100 breakdown backing quality_score. Dynamic keys (KB-checklist-derived) or the 5-dimension fallback (clarity/testability/atomicity/style/rationale). Null whenever quality_score is null.

quality_category_checklist.description: Per-category citation text backing a subset of quality_category_scores' keys -- maps a category key to the org's own ingested quality-checklist document's stated definition for it, when one was found (see KbVectorStore.get_quality_checklist_definitions). Not all-or-nothing like quality_category_scores: a category absent from this map is a real, expected case (no KB standard at all, or the org's document states no separate definition for that one category), not a parse failure. Null when nothing matched.

kind.description: Closed vocabulary (app.workitem.model.WarningKind). ado_verification_failed is deliberately absent -- that kind is only ever added by the orchestrator's own post-processing, never by ingestion's /level response this schema describes.

severity.description: auto_fixed: deterministic code already resolved it, no action needed. needs_review: an AI/heuristic judgment call a human should verify. pipeline_issue: something broke or was incomplete for this run.

node_ids.description: Affected local ids, if any -- what a 'Review item' UI affordance iterates over. Empty when the warning describes content that never became a node (e.g. a dropped row/block).

detail.description: Kind-specific structured payload (e.g. targetFeatureId, threshold, rawType) -- see each WarningKind's own emission site for its shape.

raw.description: The fully-formed human sentence -- always populated, so a client that doesn't recognize `kind` yet can still show something sane.
